text:
Alex Morgan: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3912 is targetting the Sunday deploy window (03:00 UTC). Needs a quick review + SRE thumbs for the DB compaction flag. I can rebase if reviewers are free.
Priya Nair: Quick q — which e2e suites are impacted? macos and perf smoke only?
Alex Morgan: primarily macos-e2e and migration smoke. No schema changes, but we toggle compaction=false during migrate.
Sam O'Neill: @Alex Morgan please add the `sre-eyes` label and the runbook snippet under PR description. SRE needs a short rollback plan and a toggle to disable compaction if we see high I/O.
Lina Chen: I can give a code review in ~90m. ping me then.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC — channel eng-releases notified.
ci-bot: CI status for PR #3912: macos-e2e (flake) ❌, linux-smoke ✅, integration ✅. Rerun recommended.
Alex Morgan: re-ran macos-e2e; got a transient flake in webdriver wait. Logs: ```TimeoutException: waiting for element > 30s at tests/session.test.ts:42``` — retrying now.
Priya Nair: If it's a transient webdriver flake, can we quarantine the test and run the rest? We don't want to block the whole PR.
Sam O'Neill: Quarantine makes sense for Sunday push. Two asks: (1) ensure the toggle is in the runbook and (2) SRE will be on-call at 02:45 UTC to validate compaction disabled.
Lina Chen: quick note: there's a minor merge conflict with main (ci config). Please rebase onto main to pick up the test-quarantine marker.
Alex Morgan: rebased and pushed. Triggering CI with `./scripts/ci retry --pr 3912`.
ci-bot: macos-e2e (rerun) — started. ETA ~18m.
Priya Nair: FYI I'm smoke-running the migration locally against a snapshot, looks good. Will post a one-liner in PR about observed I/O.
Alex Morgan: added `sre-eyes` label, appended a rollback plan, and noted the compaction toggle in the runbook section of the PR.
Lina Chen: reviewing now — small nit on a timeout constant, otherwise LGTM. Approving in PR.
Sam O'Neill: SRE: confirmed we have a manual fallback to re-enable compaction and step down the job. I'll be ready to press merge at 02:55 UTC after the canary check.
Alex Morgan: thanks — can someone from release team press merge? I need to be hands-on for post-deploy checks but can't be the clicker.
Sam O'Neill: I'll handle merge and monitor. Sam O'Neill: final note — hold merge until deploy-bot signals green for predeploy checks at 02:58 UTC.
Priya Nair: I'll run a quick smoke at 03:10 UTC and report back.
Alex Morgan: excellent. Tagging this thread as the Sunday-deploy handshake. I'll follow up in the PR with the final verification checklist. :thumbsup:
Lina Chen: approved. Good luck y'all.
ci-bot: macos-e2e (rerun) — passed ✅. All checks green.
Alex Morgan: final: merge scheduled at 02:59 UTC; Sam will press merge. Leaving post-deploy checklist in PR.
Sam O'Neill: pressing merge at 02:59 UTC, monitoring logs. If anything high I/O, I'll roll back and notify here.
Alex Morgan: appreciated — will watch metrics.
Priya Nair: will post smoke confirmation by 03:12 UTC.
Sam O'Neill: post-deploy: smoke ✅, I/O within expected range. Closing loop.
Alex Morgan: closing the loop — thanks everyone for quick eyes and the handoff.
